author: The Current
description:
Minneapolis high-energy, alt-punk trio Heart to Gold talk about their big upcoming year, including their first-ever headlining gig at First Avenue, upcoming US and Japan tour, and Minnesota Yacht Club Festival slot. Heart to Gold at The Current’s Local Artist of the Month this February 2026.

Guests:
Grant Whiteoak - singer/guitarist
Blake Kuethe - drummer
Jim Kisser - bassist

Host/producer - Diane Miller
Producer - Evan Clark
Graphics – Natalia Toledo
Video - Evan Clark, Alex Simpson
title: @hearttogold on working with producer Will Yip #hearttogold #willyip #minnesotamusic

author: The Current
description:
In an interview with Morning Show Host Jill Riley, Nathan Stocker of Hippo Campus talks about playing guitar on "Godspeed" and "Beautiful Stangers" off of Mavis Staples' 2025 album 'Sad And Beautiful World.'

Those tracks resulted in two Grammys for Staples -- "Godspeed" winning Best Americana Performance and "Beautiful Stangers" winning Best American Roots Performance.
title: Nathan Stocker of @HippoCampusMN talks about working on the award-winning @mavisstaples album
